summary: Dell Technologies Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement to issue and sell $3.0 billion aggregate principal amount of senior notes across three tranches: $1.0B of 4.750% notes due 2031, $750M of 5.000% notes due 2034, and $1.25B of 5.250% notes due 2037. The notes are guaranteed by Dell Technologies and subsidiaries. The offering is registered on Form S-3ASR. Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, possibly including debt repayment. This is a routine debt financing; no special-situation event triggers the filing.
